content:
maya: Quick copy review: the 'Scale up pool' confirmation modal is vague. Current header: `Confirm scale up` body: `This will increase capacity and cost.` Buttons: `Confirm` / `Cancel`. Need clearer billing and commitment language.
ian: Yep — customers ask whether this changes their invoice immediately, whether it's prorated, and if they can reverse the change. Avoid surprise billing.
sasha: Suggestions (short + clear):
1) Short: Header: "Scale up dedicated pool" Body: "Increasing capacity may change your monthly charge. Changes are prorated." Primary: "Scale up" Secondary: "Cancel"
2) Informational: Header: "Confirm capacity increase" Body: "This will add 4 GPUs to your Dedicated pool. Charges are prorated from the time of change. You can reduce capacity later; usage during this period will be billed." Primary: "Confirm and scale" Secondary: "Review billing details"
3) Reassuring + actionable: Header: "Increase Dedicated capacity" Body: "Well add 4 GPUs to your Dedicated pool starting now. Your next invoice will include prorated charges for the added capacity. You can scale back at any time; reducing capacity does not refund past usage. Learn more about billing." Primary: "Scale now" Secondary: "Open billing info" Link: "Billing docs"
kevin: I prefer variant 3 but tweak phrasing: avoid contractions like "Well" and avoid 'refund' phrasing (legal). Instead say "reductions do not apply to charges already incurred." Also show estimated monthly delta when possible, e.g., "~$1,200/mo (estimated)" or a short tag "est. +$1,200/mo" next to the header.
design-bot: [automated] Current modal header=`Confirm scale up` body=`This will increase capacity and cost.` buttons=[Confirm, Cancel] severity=warning code=SCALE_UP_CONFIRM retention=10s
maya: Accessibility: modal should be announced with role=dialog and aria-labelledby pointing to the header. SR-friendly body text should be short: "Scaling up will increase your monthly charges. Charges are prorated. See billing details." Avoid adding parentheses or punctuation that SR pauses on.
ian: Microcopy for billing link tooltip: "Estimated cost shows expected monthly change; actual charges may vary based on usage and billing cycle." Keep that 1 line only.
sasha: UX nit: primary button label should be explicit action with consequence: e.g., "Scale and bill" is too harsh. Prefer "Scale now" + small inline helper text under button: "Estimated +$1,200/mo". For org-level admins show 'Requires org approval' badge if they lack rights.
kevin: Also track telemetry: events scale_confirmed, scale_cancelled, scale_view_billing. Include the chosen capacity delta in payload. Helpful for support.
maya: Edge cases: if customer is on trial or prepaid commit, copy must change. For trials: "This change requires a paid plan" or disable button with tooltip. For committed contracts routing to sales, show contact-sales link.
design-bot: [automated] Suggested SR text: "Confirm scaling up Dedicated capacity. Charges are prorated and billed according to usage. Press Scale now to proceed or Cancel to keep current capacity."
ian: Final compromise copy for PR: Header: "Scale Dedicated capacity" Body: "Add 4 GPUs to your Dedicated pool now. Charges are prorated and will appear on your next invoice. Reducing capacity later will not change charges already incurred." Primary button: "Scale now" Secondary: "Review billing details" Inline helper: "Est. +$1,200/mo" (if available) SR string: "Scale Dedicated capacity Add four GPUs to your Dedicated pool now Charges are prorated and will appear on your next invoice Reducing capacity later will not change charges already incurred Scale now Review billing details"
sasha: Approve that wording. Maya please include variants for trial/commit states in the PR and mockups for mobile.
maya: Action items: 1) I'll update the modal copy and include SR strings and a compact mobile layout. 2) Ian/Kevin, can you wire the estimated delta and telemetry? 3) Sasha, can you check legal-approved phrasing for refund/charge language? I'll open the PR later today with screenshots. Thanks!
